items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And I once had Teddy Kotick on bass

ctx.x: I mean was there enough jazz gigs around for you to live on it?

Well not primarily jazz, I guess they were casuals, you know like the bar mitzvahs, the weddings, some of those things. I did have a small group, I don’t know what year it was, several groups at a club called The Composer, I don’t know if you ever heard of that room. And I once had Teddy Kotick on bass and guess who the intermission pianist was?
